_doc: verify --quick = the core set plus at most maxExtras scenarios mapped to the changed files (git status vs HEAD, untracked included). An area path is a prefix of a changed file; a file uses only its most specific areas (the longest matching path), so a fallback like src/ui/ never adds its list on top of src/ui/hud/. Test files and harness/state map to nothing. A changed harness/verify/scripts/<name>.js adds every scenario that uses it, a changed scenarios.json entry adds that scenario; both rank first. Keep areas narrow: list the scenarios that really exercise the files. Selection code: harness/bin/quickset.mjs. --quick --dry [--changed a,b] prints the set and why. --quick --full runs every non-allOnly scenario. Aim for a core of about 20 to 30 scenarios that together touch every shared system once.
